intro: One large piece of peanut apam balik has an estimated 250 kcal. The calories come from the pancake, crushed peanuts, sugar and margarine.
diet: Yes, but control the size. One large piece is already like a full snack. If you buy a whole one and finish it alone, it can hit 700-1000 kcal. Sharing with the family is the safer way.
tips: Ask the seller to cut it into small pieces and share with the family.
Pick the plain peanut filling, skip extra cheese and chocolate.
Ask for less margarine on top if you can.

swap.name: Thin crispy apam balik, 1 piece
swap.why: Same taste, but thinner so less flour and sugar.

faq.q: Are apam balik and martabak manis the same?
faq.a: More or less. Martabak manis is the Indonesian name, apam balik is the Malaysian name.

faq.q: Why doesn't my apam balik turn fluffy?
faq.a: Usually not enough baking soda or the batter wasn't rested. Rest the batter for at least an hour.

faq.q: Can I keep apam balik for tomorrow?
faq.a: Yes, in a closed container. Reheat briefly in a pan or air fryer to soften it again.
